card.statement:
Let $\cC = \oplus_{X\in G/K}\cC_X$ be a $G/K$-graded braided monoidal category. Suppose that there exists a braided monoidal functor $F:\cG(G,c)\to\cC$ such that $F([x])\in\cC_x$ (here we identify $x$ with its coset modulo $K$) and such that $F([x])$ being transparent with $\cC_e$. Suppose also that there are isomorphisms $\psi_x:F([x])\to I$ with the identity object for every $x\in K$. Then as braided monoidal category

$$\cC\simeq \cC_e\boxtimes\cG(G/K,q),$$

where $q$ is defined as in proposition <<ref:fact>>.
card.label: Theorem 19

paper.title: Commutative algebras in Drinfeld categories of abelian Lie algebras.
paper.abstract: We describe (braided-)commutative algebras with non-degenerate multiplicative form in certain braided monoidal categories, corresponding to abelian metric Lie algebras (so-called Drinfeld categories). We also describe local modules over these algebras and classify commutative algebras with finite number of simple local modules.
